hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash #set -euo pipefail # Simple AWS S3 optimizations export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}"
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need docker need tar need sed need grep need cut
: "${WORKSPACE:?WORKSPACE must be set by Jenkins}" : "${GIT_BRANCH:?GIT_BRANCH must be set by Jenkins}" : "${GIT_COMMIT:?GIT_COMMIT must be set by Jenkins}"
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}" S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
cleanup() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { log "Assuming role ${ROLE_ARN} (duration=${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json" log "Role assumed" }
# ----------------------------- # Build image (with FROM hotfix) # ----------------------------- GIT_BRANCH_SHORT="$(echo "${GIT_BRANCH}" | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}')" GIT_COMMIT_SHORT="$(echo "${GIT_COMMIT}" | cut -c1-7)"
ETL_DIR="${WORKSPACE}/docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl" HPDS_DIR="${ETL_DIR}/hpds"
cd "$ETL_DIR"
DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile" if grep -qE '^FROM[[:space:]]+openjdk:11-jre-slim' "$DOCKERFILE"; then warn "Detected deprecated base image openjdk:11-jre-slim" log "Hot-fixing to eclipse-temurin:11-jre-jammy" sed -i 's|^FROM[[:space:]]\+openjdk:11-jre-slim|FROM eclipse-temurin:11-jre-jammy|' "$DOCKERFILE" else log "Base image OK; no hot-fix needed" fi
IMAGE_TAG="hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-etl:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" log "Building image: ${IMAGE_TAG}" docker build -t "$IMAGE_TAG" .
# Optional: keep your tar.gz artifact behavior (unchanged) mkdir -p "${WORKSPACE}/docker_image_output" cd "${WORKSPACE}/docker_image_output" docker save "$IMAGE_TAG" | gzip > pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz docker load < ./pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz >/dev/null log "Image ready: ${IMAGE_TAG}"
# ----------------------------- # Prepare inputs in Jenkins workspace # (these files live in the Jenkins container FS) # ----------------------------- mkdir -p "$HPDS_DIR" cd "$ETL_DIR"
assume_role
log "Downloading allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv -> hpds/allConcepts.csv" aws s3 cp \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv" \ "${HPDS_DIR}/allConcepts.csv" \ --no-progress
log "Generating encryption_key -> hpds/encryption_key" #tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' < /dev/urandom | fold -w 32 | head -n 1 > "${HPDS_DIR}/encryption_key" set +o pipefail cat /dev/urandom | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | fold -w 32 | head -n 1 > hpds/encryption_key set -o pipefail cleanup
# ----------------------------- # IMPORTANT FIX: # If Docker daemon is on the host, bind-mounting $PWD/hpds from inside Jenkins # often mounts an empty host path. Use a Docker VOLUME and stream files into it. # ----------------------------- VOL="hpds_etl_${JOB_NAME:-job}_${BUILD_NUMBER:-0}" # sanitize volume name (docker volume names are picky) VOL="$(echo "$VOL" | tr ' /:@' '____')"
log "Creating docker volume: ${VOL}" docker volume rm -f "$VOL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true docker volume create "$VOL" >/dev/null
log "Streaming inputs into volume (allConcepts.csv, encryption_key)" docker run --rm -i -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc 'cat > /data/allConcepts.csv' < "${HPDS_DIR}/allConcepts.csv" docker run --rm -i -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc 'cat > /data/encryption_key' < "${HPDS_DIR}/encryption_key"
log "Sanity check volume contents" docker run --rm -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc 'ls -la /data && test -s /data/allConcepts.csv && test -s /data/encryption_key'
# ----------------------------- # Run loader container using the volume # ----------------------------- log "Running CSVLoaderNewSearch (writes *.javabin + columnMeta.csv into /opt/local/hpds)" docker run --rm \ -v "${VOL}:/opt/local/hpds" \ -v "${VOL}:/opt/local/phenocube" \ -e NO_ROLLUP=NO_ROLLUP \ -e HEAPSIZE=8192 \ -e LOADER_NAME=CSVLoaderNewSearch \ "$IMAGE_TAG"
# ----------------------------- # Pull metadata + stigvars (and stream them into the same volume) # so we can package everything from one place. # ----------------------------- assume_role
log "Downloading metadata_new_search.json -> metadata.json" aws s3 cp \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" \ "${HPDS_DIR}/metadata.json" \ --no-progress
log "Downloading conceptsToRemove.txt -> conceptsToRemove.txt" aws s3 cp \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/conceptsToRemove.txt" \ "${HPDS_DIR}/conceptsToRemove.txt" \ --no-progress
cleanup
log "Streaming metadata.json + conceptsToRemove.txt into volume" docker run --rm -i -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc 'cat > /data/metadata.json' < "${HPDS_DIR}/metadata.json" docker run --rm -i -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc 'cat > /data/conceptsToRemove.txt' < "${HPDS_DIR}/conceptsToRemove.txt"
# ----------------------------- # Build final tar from volume and write it into Jenkins workspace # (no bind mounts required) # ----------------------------- ts="$(date '+%m-%d-%yT%H')" OUT_TAR="${WORKSPACE}/biodatacatalyst_javabins_data_analyzer_${ts}.tar"
log "Creating final tar from volume -> ${OUT_TAR}" docker run --rm -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc ' set -euo pipefail cd /data
echo "Volume listing:" >&2 ls -la >&2
test -s columnMeta.csv test -s encryption_key test -s metadata.json test -s conceptsToRemove.txt
# ensure at least one javabin exists cnt="$(ls -1 *.javabin 2>/dev/null | wc -l)" if [ "$cnt" -lt 1 ]; then echo "ERROR: no *.javabin files produced" >&2 exit 3 fi
tar -cf - columnMeta.csv *.javabin encryption_key metadata.json conceptsToRemove.txt ' > "${OUT_TAR}"
test -s "${OUT_TAR}" log "Tar created (bytes=$(wc -c < "${OUT_TAR}"))"
# ----------------------------- # Upload outputs # ----------------------------- assume_role
log "Uploading tar -> s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/" aws s3 cp \ "${OUT_TAR}" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/$(basename "${OUT_TAR}")" \ --no-progress
log "Uploading columnMeta.csv -> s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv" # pull columnMeta.csv out of volume and upload from workspace (keeps S3 upload simple) docker run --rm -v "${VOL}:/data" alpine:3.20 sh -lc 'cat /data/columnMeta.csv' > "${WORKSPACE}/columnMeta.csv" aws s3 cp \ "${WORKSPACE}/columnMeta.csv" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv" \ --no-progress
cleanup
echo "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/$(basename "${OUT_TAR}")" > "${WORKSPACE}/data_analyzer_javabin_file_name.txt"
log "Done"
# Optional cleanup of docker volume (uncomment if you don’t want to keep it) docker volume rm -f "${VOL}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
